versions.content: Name Eth Trcv_ Link State Type Kind Enumeration Range ETHTRCV_ LINK_ STATE_ DOWN 0x00 No physical Ethernet connection established ETHTRCV_ LINK_ STATE_ ACTIVE 0x01 Physical Ethernet connection established Description This type defines the Ethernet link state.
